en: A two-handed swing of the Dacian falx. Rome redesigned its helmets because of this.
A wide arc that hits every enemy standing next to you. Personal space, enforced.
Raise the wolf-headed Draco banner. It howls. Enemies within 3 cells must attack you; allies nearby get a shield.
Salvaged Lobizi tech duct-taped to an iron blade. Heavy hit that ignores armour.
Flick a sharpened knucklebone. Not yours, hopefully.
A ranged curse that freezes the marrow. The target loses 3 AP on its next turn.
Call a fallen body back up as a strigoi that fights for you until the battle ends. It does not get paid.
Jam a knucklebone into a dead Lobizi machine until it agrees to be a turret. Works where magic does not.
Zalmoxis teaches peace. Zalmoxis is not here right now.
Heal one ally and wash away bleeding, chill and other bad decisions.
Spray glowing Lobizi med-gel over an area. Heals a little now and a little more for 2 turns. Smells of mint and ozone.
Slap healing herbs on an ally. Restores 10 HP.
A javelin designed to bend so you cannot throw it back. Rude.
A long Lobizi-issue spear. Reaches two cells.
Bites everything nearby and drinks the blood, healing itself and its friends.
A cattle probe, recalibrated for Dacians. Slows the target.
A scalpel the length of a canoe. Reaches two cells.
Drops a specimen tank on a cell. It blocks movement and gives cover. The tank is labelled 'DACIAN (SMALL)'.
Switches gravity off around a cell for 3 turns. Units there float and drift.
A cloud of sleepy gas that shoves everyone nearby 2 cells back and slows them.
Summons a probe drone. The drone arrives in under 188 hours, for once.
A tarabostes: armoured Dacian noble with shield and falx. Protects the party by standing where the pain is.
A strigoi-caller. Every enemy that falls is a resource. HR has concerns.
A priest of Zalmoxis, god of the afterlife, who would prefer you postpone it.
A curved two-handed blade. Legionaries started wearing arm guards because of it. +3 damage.
The curved Dacian dagger. Romans called anyone who carried one a sicarius, which is rich coming from Rome. +2 damage.
Cut from a tree near the temple. The tree has forgiven no one. +1 damage, +1 spirit.
Warm, smelly, and a clear message to other wolves. +1 armour.
Bronze scales on leather. Clinks when you sneak. +2 armour.
Segmented plate. The previous owner has retired from Rome. +3 armour, -1 agility.
A clay figurine of a very tall cow. Use it on the world map and the next UFO that spots you chases the cow instead.
A pocket-sized wolf-headed banner. Howls faintly in a breeze. +1 might.
Carved with the god's sign. Smells faintly of incense and certainty. +1 spirit.
A round Dacian loaf. Feeds the party: +3 food.
Mountain herbs, picked by someone who knew which ones. In battle, heals an ally for 10 HP.
A humming Lobizi battery. Restores 6 charge to one party member.
Salvage. A surgical blade the length of a canoe. Worth a fortune to the right blacksmith.
Salvage. It wants to float. Keep it in a bag with a rock on top.
Salvage. Glowing green paste in a glass tube. Labelled in a language that is mostly numbers in base 12.
A giant's notebook full of tiny drawings of you. Read it to add its page to the scroll.
A sliver of the mirror that links the Lobizi to the spirits above. Look into it to add its page to the scroll.
A wax tablet of complaints about Trajan. Read it to add its page to the scroll.
Back taxes from a man who has been dead for a while. Coins slightly damp.
A box the size of a hut, stamped 'FRAGILE' in base 12. Ordered 188 hours ago. Delivered never.
